label: Conto titoli ordinario (dichiarativo)
Italien 2025: en homogen post noterade a: Italy 2025: one homogeneous lot of listed shares with actual acquisition cost, annual declarative taxation only. Gains and dividends are taxed at 26%. Share losses offset share gains, never dividends or interest, and can be carried forward for four years. Amministrato with chronological loss ordering, government bonds, funds and pension accounts are excluded. The 0.2% stamp tax is calculated separately from the provider’s actual taxable value and holding days; withdrawals are never used to guess that value. The annual charge is booked on December 31 or at closure with verified closure data; other reporting frequencies are excluded. Further purchases and reinvested dividends require separate lots.
